title: Chrono Crusade
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1920s New York, Sister Rosette Christopher, an exorcist nun of the Order of Magdalene, hunts demons with her partner Chrono, a demon bound to her by a contract that slowly drains her life. She searches for her younger brother Joshua, taken by the rebel demon Aion, and is joined by Azmaria, a young girl whose healing voice marks her as one of the Apostles. The manga diverges from the better-known anime after its fourth volume.
life_message: Spend a short life fully and fearlessly for the people you love, even at the cost of yourself.
